newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock allocates HK$5.0 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock allocates HK$5.0 bln loan.

text.p: Wheelock and Co has allocated its HK$5.0 billion revolving credit/term loan facility, arranger Citicorp International said.
Coordinating arrrangers, with HK$250 million each, are Banque Nationale de Paris, Citicorp International, J.P. Morgan Securities and NatWest Markets.

Lead arrangers are Commerz (East Asia), Bayerische Hypobank Hong Kong, Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong, Credit Suisse, Hang Seng Bank, Sakura Bank, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong and Sumitomo Bank Hong Kong, with HK$250 million each, and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank and Westdeutsche Landesbank, with HK$227.5 million each.
Arrangers are Royal Bank of Canada, with HK$165 million, and Fuji Bank, KEB (Asia) Finance and Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp Hong Kong, with HK$150 million each.
Co-arrangers, with HK$150 million each, are Nippon Credit Bank Hong Kong and Tokai Bank Hong Kong.
Lead manager DG Bank Hong Kong committed HK$110 million.
Senior manager Banca Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong committed HK$100 million.
